lots.title: Specialist Vehicle Contract Hire / Leasing (framework-wide scope)
lots.description: ESPO Framework Agreement Ref 218_26 covering the provision of specialist vehicle contract hire / leasing to Customers under call-off with or without further competitive selection. This source document (Framework Agreement Appendix A) expresses a single framework-wide scope; detailed per-lot specification content is explicitly deferred by Framework Schedule 1 to Section 2 of the Invitation to Tender (Requirement) and is not present in this document.
requirements: Supplier shall provide Goods and/or Services described as 'specialist vehicle contract hire / leasing' to Customers identified in the Tender Notice (Background A).
Any Goods supplied to Customers pursuant to a Contract shall conform to a Specification and the Call-Off Terms (clause 7.5).
Supplier shall comply with the Standards and the Law in performing its obligations (clause 13.2) and obtain and maintain all licences, authorisations, consents or permits (clause 13.1).

Tendered pricing shall include: Vehicle (and associated equipment); mileage/hours usage; maintenance (and parts/ancillary products where required); scheduled manufacturers recommended servicing; MOT (where required); relevant manuals/handbooks; statutory fees (namely first registration fee where required and VED); and any other regulatory levies and duties (Framework Schedule 1, Tendered pricing block).

Other administrative charges to be stated in the Price Schedule (Appendix B), if applicable: excess mileage charge / under-run credits; cancellation fee (prior to delivery); early termination fee; processing fees for penalty charge notices (PCNs); delivery/collection fees (Framework Schedule 1).
Tenderers must state their policy in respect of repairs for vehicle accident damage / misuse / write-offs (Framework Schedule 1).
Supplier shall meet or exceed the Key Performance Indicators in Annex A of Framework Schedule 10 (clause 7.1.11).
Framework Fee of 1% of invoiced Contract Charges is payable by the Supplier to ESPO (Framework Schedule 2, clause 1.4).
Supplier shall submit Quarterly MI Reports by the Reporting Date using the prescribed MI Reporting Template (Framework Schedule 7, clauses 2.1 and 3.1).

Any additions or amendments to Goods and/or Services in Schedule 1 require ESPO Approval and must be technical developments or improvements to what was originally tendered (clauses 3.5, 1.4-1.7 of Schedule 1, clause 32.1).
